seeds.name: Wheat Seeds
seeds.description: A sturdy grain that grows on a short two-day cycle.
seeds.description_zh: 结实耐种的谷物，两天左右就能完成一轮生长。

seeds.name: Herb Cuttings
seeds.description: Fast-growing greens used for light kitchen prep.
seeds.description_zh: 生长很快的绿植，适合轻量厨房备料。

seeds.name: Mooncap Mycelium
seeds.description: Night-borne spores stabilized for a delicate premium crop that feeds Mooncap Hotpot.
seeds.description_zh: 由夜间孢子稳定而成的精细高价作物，可用于月菇火锅。

seeds.name: Kelpberry Starts
seeds.description: A hardy shoreline berry cultivated for steady daytime sale value.
seeds.description_zh: 生长稳健的岸边莓果，适合提供稳定的白天出售收益。

seeds.name: Emberleaf Pods
seeds.description: A peppery leaf crop that sells well once the farm can spare the effort.
seeds.description_zh: 带辛香的叶类作物，农场余力充足时卖价很不错。
